summary: Comprehensive test suite with multiple testing layers (unit tests, structure validation, e2e via act). Covers all three retention policies (max_age, keep_latest_n, max_total_size), policy interactions, error handling across input validation, CLI integration, and full workflow validation including actionlint assertions. Well-organized by functionality (6 TDD cycles), excellent use of fixture helpers (_artifact, _write). Rigor gaps: missing boundary condition tests (exact cutoff dates, zero/negative budgets), doesn't verify tie-breaking for identical timestamps, no test for policy with all None values (though code rejects it). Would reliably catch most regressions; edge cases in sorting/budgeting might slip through. Requires fixture files (fixtures/cases/*/artifacts.json, .github/workflows/artifact-cleanup-script.yml) assumed present per task requirements.
